PLAN.replay_rule: same idempotency_key + same complete semantics (complete_external_identity identical) -> durable replay of committed terminal result, no duplicate external attempt
PLAN.conflict_rule: same idempotency_key + authorization drift (principal/operation/target/scope/contract/intent/subject_rev/authorities/candidate/lease drift changes complete identity) -> CONFLICT fail closed, no replay, no overwrite
PLAN.durable_storage: idempotency_key index in journal store with complete_external_identity comparison; before creating new PREPARED scan existing journal with same idempotency_key; if found with same complete identity and terminal success, return replayed result
PLAN.opaque_id_not_authority: journal_id/opaque token never decides replay; only complete identity does
PLAN.operation_reuse: plan_init and plan_retirement are closed operation set per D10; no generic external mutation API
